analysis: Exploratory fixed-model association of improvement with constituent property strata
definition: improvement = abs(Anderson - DFT) - abs(ML - DFT); positive means ML lowers absolute error
point_weights: Equal physical material pairs within each source, equal source weights within each stratum; pair configurations conditional on stratum share pair weight
threshold_policy: All seven named properties use their existing 11561-row fit_core median, without test-outcome threshold search

bootstrap.scheme: Synchronized multinomial draws over all held-out composition groups; recompute source/pair weights in each stratum
bootstrap.intervals: pointwise percentile 95%; descriptive, unadjusted for seven correlated properties

scope: Current Janus/HetDB frozen 721 supported holdouts; not an input ablation or prospective domain guarantee
